meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你接入 Mattermost:先找本机已有的服务器,没有就询问是否创建本地评估版;再配置服务器地址、机器人账号和回调,让 NanoClaw 能通过 Mattermost 收发私信、频道消息和审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 添加 Mattermost 机器人频道、连接 Mattermost 服务器或把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 频道
我想把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择或创建服务器,并配置机器人。

howto.what_en: Claude guides adding Mattermost: checks for an existing local server, offers to create an evaluation server if none, then sets up server URL, bot account, and callback so NanoClaw can use Mattermost for DMs, channels, and approval cards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a Mattermost bot channel, connect a Mattermost server, or integrate Mattermost with NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude checks for an existing Mattermost server first.

say_en.text: I want to connect Mattermost to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude guides server choice and bot setup.
Claude walks you through creating a bot and getting a token.
